fields.YouTube title: ICMR Reaches 100 Technology Transfers | India’s Medical Innovation
fields.YouTube description (includes hashtags):
India is bringing more of its medical research closer to real-world healthcare.

At the DHR–ICMR Health Research Excellence Summit in November 2026, the Indian Council of Medical Research announced 100 cumulative technology-transfer deals. At the summit, 20 licensing agreements covering eight medical technologies were exchanged with nine Indian companies.

Earlier transfers under the Patent Mitra initiative included bacterial vaccine technologies, diagnostic tests for tuberculosis and mpox, and an experimental therapy for a precancerous cervical condition. Licensing is a step towards further development, testing and possible manufacturing; it does not establish clinical approval or commercial availability.
